notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) building an in-app AI assistant and search/ranking features. Primary stakeholders: VP Product (Elena Pemberton), Head of ML (Derek Hsu), Platform Eng (Rosa Kim).

Sales/technical notes (shorthand):
- Customer path: started with Hosted API demo -> wants Dedicated for SLA + data isolation if numbers work.
- POC on Hosted to gather real token distribution; will run 2-week load window (peak sim).
- Primary asks: predictable latency under 100ms p50 for chat, 500ms p95 for short context reranking (<=512 tokens), cost target <$0.06 per 1k tokens effective after batching/caching.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS for key separation, audit logs retained 1 year, EU data residency for subset of customers.
- "We can't expose raw customer documents outside VPC" — quote from Platform Eng (Rosa). They want Private/Dedicated options evaluated for GDPR accounts.
- Quantization appetite: willing to accept FP16->INT8 if accuracy loss <2% on intent classification.
- Latency sensitivity: interactive product managers care about p50 p95 for chat; sales demos require sub-second responses.
- Currently evaluating cost tradeoffs: batch size vs latency, caching prefix for common queries (saved prompts), model family tradeoffs (Llama-family vs higher perf variants).
- Risk: budget sign-off timeline tied to Q2 procurement; need clear NRAs for estimated ARR.

Action items we own:
- Deliver cost model spreadsheet with modeled batching/caching scenarios (Marcus).
- Run quantization profile POC on customer prompt set (engineers).
- Provide Dedicated sizing options and committed pricing tiers (pricing ops + AE).
- Prepare security addendum skeleton for KMS and data residency (security team).

Stated objection: "If Dedicated doesn't reduce unit costs enough, we can't justify migration from Hosted" — finance lead.

Customer tone: pragmatic, cost-conscious, technical. Wants measurable unit economics and SLOs before committing.
requirements_summary: Use-case: in-app assistant + contextual reranking for product docs and support. Targets: chat p50 <100ms, p95 <400-500ms for typical prompts, throughput 50-120 requests/s with bursts to 400/s. Must maintain SOC2-level controls, SSO, KMS, and EU data residency for regulated customers. Interested in Hosted for quick start; evaluating Dedicated if cost per token after optimizations (batching/caching/quantization) meets procurement thresholds.
commercial_notes: Customer prefers committed reserved pricing for Dedicated if 12-month ARR falls within estimated range; negotiating burst credits and uplift for autoscaling. Wants an itemized TCO comparing Hosted vs Dedicated including engineering ops cost assumptions.
closing_risks: Procurement calendar (Q2), KMS/HSM integration timeline, measurable accuracy delta from quantized models
recent_competitor_activity: Customer ran benchmarks with Anthropic Claude2 and OpenAI; primary complaint was cost at scale and lack of routing by cost tier. Considering self-hosting but concerned about ops overhead.
